integrity: The analytic coefficient was independently reconstructed from the lens-transform formula and Hermite moments. A standard-library checker replays the exact moment and coefficient arithmetic. Literature originality remains subject to the stated residual indexing risk.
scientific_limitations: The result proves positivity of the optimized fourth-order Lyapunov--Schmidt coefficient at the one-dimensional threshold but does not establish full local maximality; uniform infinite-dimensional higher-order remainder control is not supplied.
title: Positive quartic reduction at the one-dimensional mixed-norm Strichartz threshold
